outcomes.can: Trace an accumulator on a list and an empty list.

intro: An array stores values in order. number[] describes an array of numbers. [] is empty. A for-of loop visits each value once. A variable declared before the loop can accumulate a result across visits. The array’s length counts its entries. To build a new list, start from [] and use push(value) to append an entry.
